cohort: Pregnant women with a positive SARS-CoV-2 nasopharyngeal swab within 7 days of hospital admission in Italy, between January 1 and May 31, 2022
finding: Unvaccinated pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 during the Omicron wave had a significantly higher risk of developing moderate or severe COVID-19 compared to vaccinated women.
mod_finding: Women with moderate or severe COVID-19 had a higher percentage of preterm birth and caesarean section compared to those with milder cases.
